title: e0vk(3): CONFIG_LICHEN_RPL_ROOT_SIG Kconfig gating root-side signature inclusion (after (2))
description: Parent: project-LICHEN-worker6-e0vk. LANDS AFTER (2). Add CONFIG_LICHEN_RPL_ROOT_SIG to lichen/subsys/lichen/rpl/Kconfig (default y per L694 'root SHOULD include when y'); when y the root-side DIO build appends the 0x17 option (root_dio_sig encode path — needs a C encode helper for the COSE blob or reuse of a prebuilt blob); when n the option is omitted and receivers fall back to link-layer baseline per L679. Survey the root DIO build site (dodag.c / rpl_dao_build.c) for the integration point.
